hero.title: Building Africa's Premier Ethical Cashew Brand
hero.subtitle: From our family farm in Odienné, Ivory Coast to global markets — sustainable, traceable, and faith-aligned cashews.

intro.title: Transforming West Africa's Cashew Industry
content: Ivory Coast produces 45% of the world's cashews, yet less than 10% are processed locally. Most farmers live below the poverty line while the value is captured overseas. At AfriNuts Export, we are changing that.

We are building a vertically integrated, ethical cashew brand that keeps value in Africa. From our 35-hectare farm in Odienné to our future processing center, every step is owned and operated by us. No middlemen. No extraction. Just fair, transparent, faith-aligned agribusiness.

sustainability.title: Sustainability & Stewardship
sustainability.subtitle: Building a low-waste, renewable-powered cashew value chain

items.text: Our processing center will transform waste shells into biofuel, powering 30% of our energy needs
Solar-hybrid energy system projected to reduce grid dependency by 50% by 2030
100% organic farming methods — no synthetic pesticides or fertilizers on our 35 hectares
Blockchain traceability from tree to export container, launching 2028

sustainability.quote: The land is a trust (amanah). We borrow it from our children. We must return it better than we found it.

community.title: Community Empowerment
community.subtitle: Our farm is more than a business — it's a community uplift project

items.title: Farmer Training & Outgrower Program
items.content: We train local farmers in organic cashew production and provide fair, guaranteed contracts. Goal: 20+ outgrowers supplying 10% of our volume by 2028.

items.title: 10% Community Reinvestment
items.content: We allocate 10% of annual net profits to community projects: water wells, schools, mosques, and farmer training. First well planned for 2026.

items.title: Youth & Women's Employment
items.content: Priority hiring for local youth and women. Target: 50% of farm workforce from the local village, with equal pay for equal work.

value.title: Value Addition & Trade
value.subtitle: We believe Africa must export finished products, not just raw materials
items: Phase 1 (2027-2030): Processing center producing export-grade organic kernels. Target capacity: 1,000-2,000 metric tons annually.
Phase 2 (2031+): Value-added products including roasted cashews, cashew butter, and cashew milk powder.
By-product valorization: Cashew shells → biofuel. Cashew apples → juice, vinegar, and animal feed.
Target export markets: Europe (organic buyers) and Middle East (Halal-certified buyers).

finance.title: Ethical Finance
finance.subtitle: We uphold Islamic financial ethics (Sharia-compliant) in all our operations

principles.title: Riba-Free (No Interest)
principles.content: We avoid debt and interest (riba) in all financial transactions. Our investor partnerships use profit-sharing (Mudarabah) not fixed-interest loans.

principles.title: Transparent Partnerships (Musharakah)
principles.content: We share both risk and reward transparently with investors. No hidden fees. No speculative trading.

principles.title: Profit with Purpose
principles.content: We prioritize long-term community benefit over short-term gain. Our investors receive returns but also contribute to sadaqah jariyah (ongoing charity).

innovation.title: Innovation & Transformation
innovation.subtitle: Building the first locally owned, export-grade cashew brand from northwestern Côte d'Ivoire

items.title: Digital Traceability (2028+)
items.content: Batch-level blockchain tracking from our farm to the export container. Every cashew traceable.

items.title: Smart Farming (2030+)
items.content: Planned implementation of drone monitoring, soil sensors, and predictive analytics to optimize yield and reduce inputs.

items.title: International Certification (2026-2029)
items.content: Organic (2027 target), Halal (2028 target), and ISO 22000 (2029 target) for global market access.

items.title: Regional Leadership (Ongoing)
items.content: Creating a replicable model for ethical, profitable agribusiness that can scale across West Africa.

cta.title: A Movement Rooted in Vision
cta.content: Our goal is not just profitability — but to transform our region into a hub of ethical agribusiness. We're planting 3,500 cashew trees today to nourish the next generation — with faith, purpose, and excellence.

esg.title: Our Commitment to ESG
esg.subtitle: Environmental, Social, and Governance principles are embedded in everything we do.

commitments: Organic farming (no synthetic pesticides or fertilizers)
10% of profits reinvested in community (wells, schools, mosques)
Third-party audits for labor and environmental standards
Blockchain traceability from farm to export

roadmap.title: Our Strategic Roadmap: From Farm to Global Brand
roadmap.subtitle: Building a sustainable future through strategic growth and certification excellence

items.title: Foundation Phase: Farm & Supply Chain Secured
items.description: 35-hectare cashew farm fully operational in Odienné. Exclusive sourcing agreement signed with Coopérative Agricole AfriNuts, uniting 200+ local farmers.

items.title: Certification Initiation & Detailed Planning
items.description: Begin the 3-year transition for Organic certification. Finalize processing plant engineering designs, secure permits, and prepare for investment round.

items.title: Investment & Construction
items.description: Secure $1.25M investment. Break ground and construct the Phase 1 Pilot Processing Center. Begin applications for Halal and ISO 22000 certifications.

items.title: Commissioning & Market Entry
items.description: Install equipment, commission the plant, and train staff. Produce first sample batches for international buyers. Secure first Letters of Intent (LOIs).

items.title: Pilot Operations & Certification Achievement
items.description: Begin pilot-scale processing using farm and cooperative supply. Achieve full Organic, Halal, and ISO 22000 certifications. Ramp up production and refine operations.

items.title: Ramp-Up to Profitability
items.description: Reach full capacity of the Phase 1 plant (1,000-2,000 MT/year). Execute on export contracts. Target achieving operational break-even and first net profits.

items.title: Sustainable Growth & Expansion Planning
items.description: Begin dividend distributions to shareholders. Reinvest profits to fund planning and development of the Phase 2 industrial-scale facility (5,000+ MT/year).

processingLinks.title: Bringing the Vision to Life
processingLinks.subtitle: Explore how we are turning raw cashews into premium export-ready products through our processing infrastructure.

processing.title: Our Processing Approach
processing.description: From raw nut to export-ready product — discover how we add value at every stage of the cashew processing chain.

facility.title: Future Processing Facility
facility.description: Take a tour of our planned facility — from quality control labs to worker welfare, see the layout designed for efficiency and sustainability.

transparency.title: Operational Transparency Built In
transparency.subtitle: Every tree, every block, every expense — tracked and reported. Our farm management system brings institutional-grade visibility to agricultural investment.

tracking.title: Block-Level Tracking
tracking.description: Our 35-hectare farm is divided into individually monitored blocks. Each block has its own planting date, survival rate, and performance metrics — giving investors granular visibility into farm operations.

reporting.title: Investor-Grade Reporting
reporting.description: Quarterly reports include tree survival rates, harvest volumes, quality grades, and profit-and-loss statements by block. No black boxes — just clear, auditable data.

allocation.title: Transparent Cost Allocation
allocation.description: Farm-wide expenses are allocated equally per block. Direct costs are tracked per block. Our investors always know exactly where every FCFA goes.

transparency.note: Our operational dashboard and detailed financial reports are available to verified investors through a secure portal.

agritechHub.title: Beyond Cashews: Building Odienné's Agritech Future
agritechHub.subtitle: What started as a farm operating system can become a regional platform.
agritechHub.vision: AfriNuts Export is proof that a small agribusiness can build enterprise-grade technology. Our next ambition is to turn Odienné into West Africa's first agritech cluster — where farmers use mobile apps, buyers verify batches online, and investors access live performance data.

pillars.title: Digitize the Supply Chain
pillars.description: Extend Farm OS to cooperatives and outgrowers. Every farmer, every tree, every harvest tracked.

pillars.title: Train Local Talent
pillars.description: Partner with technical schools to train the next generation of Ivorian software engineers and agritech specialists.

pillars.title: Replicate the Model
pillars.description: Prove the concept in cashew, then adapt to other crops: cocoa, shea, coffee, cotton.

agritechHub.cta: Investors and government partners: join us in building the agritech future of West Africa.
